rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for attempting something, experimenting with an action, or trying something out.

example.english: I haven’t tried making this dish before, so I’ll try it today.
example.traditional: 我未試過整呢味餸，今日試吓先。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mei6 si3 gwo3 zing2 ni1 mei2 sung3 gam1 jat6 si3 haa5 sin1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a deliberate attempt or effort.

example.english: This method is worth a try.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 zik6 dak1 soeng4 si3

rows.note: Use this specifically for sampling or tasting food and drinks.

example.english: You can try these cakes without buying a whole box.
example.traditional: 呢啲蛋糕可以試食，唔使買成盒。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 daan6 gou1 ho2 ji5 si3 sik6 m4 sai2 maai5 sing4 hap6

rows.note: Use this when stressing that someone is making their maximum effort, rather than merely attempting something.

example.english: The report is due tomorrow, so I’ll try my best to do it well.
example.traditional: 份報告聽日要交，我會盡力做好。
example.jyutping: fan6 bou3 gou3 ting1 jat6 jiu3 gaau1 ngo5 wui5 zeon6 lik6 zou6 hou2
